security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Sleep or shut down after AI coding agents finish
bundle.longDescription: AgentGoodNight watches local AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode) and sleeps or shuts down the computer only after every tracked task has provably finished.
